needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this junction to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the signalised crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to allow wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids to cross the road more easily.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for all road users, especially at night.
